description.p: WayExpand turns short triggers into reusable text snippets. Type a quick abbreviation and get back your saved signatures, templates, code blocks, or anything else you retype every day.

Built for Wayland from the ground up, WayExpand uses native Wayland protocols for keyboard input and text injection rather than adapting X11 tools. It supports multiple backends depending on your compositor:

ul.li: KDE Plasma (KWin 6.6+) with evdev capture
GNOME and other compositors with input-method-v2
Sway and Hyprland via wlroots virtual-keyboard
libei/EIS for portal-mediated text injection
Graphical snippet editor with live preview
Template variables (date, time, username, custom programs)
Application-scoped snippets (KDE Plasma)
Undo last expansion with hotkey
Automatic sensitive-field detection (password fields)
Import from Espanso
No cloud, no telemetry, config stored locally
8 color packs including retro terminal themes
Language support: English, German

description.p: Privacy-first and security-focused: WayExpand never logs your triggers or replacements, validates configurations before applying them, and detects password fields to prevent accidental expansion in sensitive inputs.
